scope: Read-only evidence/mask recommendation audit of current supplied library. Does not establish scene acceptance before implementation or independent source provenance.
coverage: 20 photographic workstreams + XAUUSD + PETRA AI + credentials/about/contact closing group =23 required category groups.
global_rules: Preserve existing A/B/C/D/E classes. Current chosen photographic portfolio images are B/C, not documentary A.
Never upgrade C to documentary. Class B unconfirmed provenance receives explicit HOLD under newest fail-closed rule.
Project facts/narratives may remain verified independently of photo assignment; frame named scenes as conceptual context until imagery assignment is evidenced.
Pure same-photo masks and intact planes avoid generation; do not claim measured depth maps or automatic segmentation.
Maintenance pair35/37 is a recorded same-site pairing, not evidence of dated scope, causality or assignment.
FTA/FDP acronyms must not be expanded absent evidence; existing route slugs remain.
Any use of shared authentic installation originals must remain unassigned to named facilities.
